entities.summary: The Evangelical-Lutheran Church in Hungary is a Protestant Lutheran denomination in Hungary. In 2019, there were 176,000 baptized members. Evangelical-Lutheran Church in Hungary is a Christian denomination in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
